description: Dept. of Elections - Vacated the office of member of the Gampaha M/C by Mr. Guruge Susantha Perera
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns a member of a local authority (Gampaha Municipal Council) vacating their office due to ceasing membership in a political party (United National Party). The content is published under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and deals specifically with the electoral process and the status of an elected official, making it a clear fit for the Elections category.
